{{Top|leg}}
'''The Lock''' was a large cavern located on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]. It was sealed off from the rest of the [[Space station/Legends|station]] and accessible only by exterior [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]]. The Lock was used to secure any item that could potentially pose a threat to the station, such as canisters containing biowar cultures.
